top_signals.title: "Bull Market Could Last Through 2030:" Bartels | Open Interest 8/3/2026
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Blockbuster pharma deal talk launches a pivotal week for earnings and the economy. Oil slides as President Trump reopens Iran talks, while the US and Japan defend the yen. Plus, Mary Ann Bartels says the the bull market will last until the end of the decade. Amazon surpasses $3 trillion in value. Mark Penn, the CEO of Stagwell gives us his views on why AI won't replace marketing agencies and Suki Cooper’s path to $5,000 gold. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
